source_native_variants: risk; uncertainty effect; operational risk item
working_definition: A context-dependent risk phenomenon concerning possible effects on objectives/value; not identical to its record, narrative, score or workflow item.
conflict_notes: Polysemy across phenomenon, description, record and score; preserve source-native usage in mappings.
preferred_label_rationale: Shortest neutral anchor; exact foundational category deferred to #3/#25.
migration_lineage: NEW_PROVISIONAL_ID; stable semantic ID to be assigned under #43

source_native_variants: risk event; incident; disruption; failure
working_definition: A realized occurrence relevant to a risk context; distinct from an event type, possible scenario and textual description.
conflict_notes: Incident may imply realized past occurrence; scenario may denote possibility or description.
preferred_label_rationale: Makes realized occurrence explicit and prevents scenario/event conflation.
evidence_refs: REC-002; PA-005; PA-015; G1 event candidates

source_native_variants: scenario; possible event; risk scenario
working_definition: A possible or hypothesized risk-relevant configuration/event pattern used for analysis; not the same as its narrative text or realized event.
broader_or_refinement: related to Risk Event; represented by Scenario Description
conflict_notes: Sources overload scenario as event, type, narrative and record.
preferred_label_rationale: Preferred because it isolates the analyzed possibility from the information artifact describing it.

source_native_variants: risk description; scenario narrative; scenario text; risk narrative
working_definition: An information artifact that describes a Risk Scenario or related causal/consequence structure.
conflict_notes: Often mislabeled as the scenario/event itself.
preferred_label_rationale: Description makes information-artifact status explicit.

source_native_variants: risk record; register row; risk item; risk entry; RDR item
working_definition: An information artifact in a governed register that records risk-related information, assessments, ownership, treatment and workflow history.
broader_or_refinement: part of Risk Register; may have Risk Detail Record refinement
conflict_notes: Operational systems often collapse entry identity with Risk identity.
preferred_label_rationale: Preferred over generic Risk Record when referring to register membership; source label Risk Record remains recoverable.
migration_lineage: G1 RiskRecord* artifacts -> Risk Register Entry family

source_native_variants: risk register; central risk repository
working_definition: A managed repository or collection of Risk Register Entries for a defined scope.
conflict_notes: A register is not a set of real-world risks themselves.
preferred_label_rationale: Matches authoritative NIST information-management usage.

source_native_variants: RDR; detailed risk record
working_definition: A richer information artifact preserving detailed analysis, history and accountability beyond a compact register entry.
conflict_notes: May be confused with the underlying risk or assessment result.
preferred_label_rationale: Retains NIST-specific authoritative term while preserving information-artifact semantics.

source_native_variants: risk assessment; assess risk; analysis activity
working_definition: An activity that applies a method, evidence and context to produce one or more assessment results.
conflict_notes: Risk assessment often denotes both process and result.
preferred_label_rationale: Activity suffix prevents process/result collapse.

source_native_variants: assessment; rating; score; likelihood/impact result; exposure
working_definition: A contextual, time-bound result produced by a Risk Assessment Activity.
broader_or_refinement: specialized by likelihood, impact, exposure, inherent/residual results
conflict_notes: Operational fields often appear as timeless risk properties.
preferred_label_rationale: Result suffix makes output identity explicit.

source_native_variants: inherent risk; gross risk; pre-control risk
working_definition: A Risk Assessment Result representing an agreed pre-treatment/pre-control assessment context.
conflict_notes: Some sources model this as a separate risk entity.
preferred_label_rationale: Preferred to avoid identity duplication while preserving source term.

source_native_variants: residual risk; post-control risk; remaining risk
working_definition: A Risk Assessment Result representing an agreed post-treatment/control assessment context.
conflict_notes: Can be confused with a distinct enduring Risk entity.
preferred_label_rationale: Preferred to keep temporal/contextual assessment semantics explicit.

source_native_variants: likelihood; probability; frequency; chance
working_definition: A Risk Assessment Result concerning the estimated possibility/frequency of a specified outcome or event under an assessment method.
conflict_notes: Probability, likelihood and frequency are not universally interchangeable.
preferred_label_rationale: Neutral likelihood anchor; numerical/probabilistic semantics stay method-specific.

source_native_variants: impact; consequence severity; harm severity; loss/gain magnitude
working_definition: A Risk Assessment Result concerning magnitude/severity of effects under a specified assessment method.
conflict_notes: Impact, consequence and harm may denote result, event outcome or magnitude.
preferred_label_rationale: Result naming separates measured/estimated severity from consequence entities.

source_native_variants: risk state; current risk condition; assessed state
working_definition: A state of the risk-relevant situation/assessment context, distinct from workflow state of a management record.
conflict_notes: Frequently conflated with open/closed workflow values.
preferred_label_rationale: Explicitly protects domain state from record/process state.

source_native_variants: status; open; analyzed; treated; closed; completed; reviewed; ready
working_definition: A state of a record or management workflow indicating processing/progression, not whether a risk phenomenon exists.
broader_or_refinement: state of Risk Register Entry or workflow activity
conflict_notes: Status is highly polysemous and source-specific.
preferred_label_rationale: Workflow qualifier prevents semantic leakage into Risk State.
migration_lineage: RiskRecordWorkflowState and AnalysisWorkflowState -> Workflow State refinements

source_native_variants: owner; owning unit; accountable unit; risk owner
working_definition: A context-dependent role borne by an actor with responsibility/accountability for specified risk-management obligations.
broader_or_refinement: role related to actor and risk/register context
conflict_notes: Source values mix persons, units and role labels.
preferred_label_rationale: Role interpretation avoids organizational subclasses masquerading as semantic types.
migration_lineage: G1 RiskOwnerRole -> Risk Owner role label

source_native_variants: responsibility; accountability; assignment
working_definition: A responsibility/assignment relation connecting actors or roles to risk-management duties and artifacts.
conflict_notes: Accountability and responsibility may be distinct governance notions.
preferred_label_rationale: Keeps relation separate from role bearer identity.

source_native_variants: source; cause; driver; trigger; condition
working_definition: A risk-relevant origin/context candidate that may contribute to a scenario or event; exact causal status must be explicit.
conflict_notes: Cause, trigger, driver and condition are not synonyms.
preferred_label_rationale: Risk Source is a neutral umbrella for reconciliation only; exact relation refined in #20.

source_native_variants: cause; causes; causal link
working_definition: A relation asserting causal dependence supported by appropriate evidence/assumptions.
conflict_notes: Operational narratives often overstate causal semantics.
preferred_label_rationale: Explicit term enables claim-strength control.

source_native_variants: association; correlation; co-occurrence
working_definition: A non-causal relation indicating statistical/observational association.
conflict_notes: Often conflated with cause in risk narratives.
preferred_label_rationale: Needed to preserve evidence limitations.

source_native_variants: consequence; outcome; effect; harm; loss; gain
working_definition: A risk-relevant outcome/effect of an event or scenario; may be described and separately assessed for impact/severity.
broader_or_refinement: may be positive or negative; assessed by Impact Assessment Result
conflict_notes: Impact and consequence are often merged; harm is a narrower negative consequence in some domains.
preferred_label_rationale: Consequence preserves outcome identity while impact remains assessment result.

source_native_variants: harm; injury; damage
working_definition: A negative consequence affecting an entity/value, especially in safety/medical contexts.
conflict_notes: Not every consequence is harm; domain definitions vary.
preferred_label_rationale: Scoped to Health/safety by default rather than generalized to all Core.

source_native_variants: exposure; vulnerability exposure; exposure rating
working_definition: A context-dependent condition or assessment construct representing how an object/value is subject to a risk-relevant source/event; exact semantics are profile/method dependent.
conflict_notes: Exposure may denote real-world relation, financial amount or assessment score.
preferred_label_rationale: Kept provisional with profile-specific refinements to avoid false unification.

source_native_variants: vulnerability; susceptibility; weakness; predisposing condition
working_definition: A disposition/condition that increases susceptibility to a risk-relevant event/effect.
broader_or_refinement: related to Risk Source and Exposure
conflict_notes: Security, supply-chain and health definitions differ materially.
preferred_label_rationale: Preferred cross-domain label with profile-specific refinements required.

source_native_variants: response strategy; mitigation strategy; avoid; accept; transfer; reduce
working_definition: An information/decision artifact specifying a selected high-level approach for addressing a risk.
conflict_notes: Often collapsed with implemented controls or activities.
preferred_label_rationale: Strategy qualifier distinguishes decision choice from execution mechanism.

source_native_variants: treatment plan; mitigation plan; response plan; contingency plan
working_definition: An information artifact specifying planned treatment actions, responsibilities, timing or resources.
conflict_notes: May be confused with the treatment activity or control mechanism.
preferred_label_rationale: Plan suffix makes artifact status explicit.
migration_lineage: G1 RiskTreatmentPlan retained; ContingencyPlan as specialization candidate

source_native_variants: mitigation action; response activity; treatment action; prevention activity
working_definition: An activity performed to modify risk-relevant conditions, likelihood, consequences or preparedness.
conflict_notes: Action/activity and control object are often conflated.
preferred_label_rationale: Activity suffix clarifies perdurant/execution semantics.

source_native_variants: control; internal control; automated control; mitigation control
working_definition: A mechanism, capability or implemented measure used in risk treatment/prevention/detection; exact subtype depends on profile.
broader_or_refinement: may be used by Risk Treatment Activity
conflict_notes: Control may also denote activity, policy, system feature or evidence.
preferred_label_rationale: Mechanism is preferred as default to separate persistent measure from activity/plan.

source_native_variants: criteria; acceptance criteria; risk criteria
working_definition: Information/decision criteria used to evaluate significance, acceptability or treatment decisions.
conflict_notes: May be confused with method thresholds or workflow gates.
preferred_label_rationale: Neutral governance/method term; numeric thresholds remain method-specific.

source_native_variants: risk appetite
working_definition: Governance-level expression of the type/amount of risk an organization is prepared to pursue or retain, subject to source-specific definition.
broader_or_refinement: related to Risk Criteria and Risk Tolerance
conflict_notes: Framework definitions differ; not a universal intrinsic Risk property.
preferred_label_rationale: Keep source-native framework definitions and scope as Governance profile.

source_native_variants: tolerance; threshold; acceptable variation
working_definition: A governance/method concept expressing permitted variation or bounds around objectives/risk criteria in a specified framework.
conflict_notes: Tolerance and appetite are often incorrectly treated as synonyms.
preferred_label_rationale: Separate preferred term because source frameworks distinguish them.

source_native_variants: evidence; compliance evidence; expert evidence; supporting information
working_definition: An information artifact used to support, challenge or contextualize a risk-related assertion, assessment or decision.
broader_or_refinement: related to Observation Result and Provenance
conflict_notes: Evidence is role-dependent; same artifact can play different evidential roles.
preferred_label_rationale: Item label emphasizes artifact identity while evidence role stays contextual.

source_native_variants: observation; monitoring; measurement activity
working_definition: An activity that observes/measures relevant phenomena and may generate observation results/evidence.
conflict_notes: Observation is often used for both activity and result.
preferred_label_rationale: Activity suffix prevents conflation.

source_native_variants: observation; measurement; monitored value
working_definition: An information/measurement result produced by observation or monitoring activity.
conflict_notes: Often conflated with activity or signal.
preferred_label_rationale: Result suffix preserves event/result distinction.

source_native_variants: signal; safety signal; pharmacovigilance signal
working_definition: An information-level indication suggesting a potentially important risk-relevant pattern requiring assessment; exact semantics are domain-specific.
broader_or_refinement: may be supported by Evidence Items
conflict_notes: Signal is not automatically a Risk or Event.
preferred_label_rationale: Scoped to Pharma/future profile by default because OpenPVSignal owns detailed PV semantics.

source_native_variants: source lineage; data provenance; evidence provenance
working_definition: Information about origin, derivation, version, agent, time and transformation history of an artifact/assertion/result.
conflict_notes: Can be reduced incorrectly to a URL or source name.
preferred_label_rationale: Needed for source→claim traceability and reassessment history.

source_native_variants: incident; realized event
working_definition: A realized adverse occurrence recognized/reported within an operational or safety context.
conflict_notes: Some sources use incident as record/ticket rather than occurrence.
preferred_label_rationale: Keep occurrence meaning in Core; incident ticket/record is an anti-concept mapping.

source_native_variants: issue; governance issue; problem
working_definition: A recognized problem/condition requiring management attention; not automatically a risk phenomenon or event.
conflict_notes: Issue-management systems may use Issue as generic ticket container.
preferred_label_rationale: Scoped to Governance/Enterprise and separated from generic UI issue records.

source_native_variants: threat; threat source; malicious/adverse agent/action
working_definition: A risk-relevant adverse source, actor, capability, action or condition capable of contributing to a harmful scenario; exact identity is profile-dependent.
broader_or_refinement: refinement/role under Risk Source depending profile
conflict_notes: Security and ERM sources use Threat differently; not synonymous with Risk or Hazard.
preferred_label_rationale: Keep explicit because it is a required cross-domain term while deferring exact foundational identity to #3/#25.

source_native_variants: hazard; hazardous source; hazardous situation precursor
working_definition: A potential source of harm under safety/medical-device semantics; not generalized as a synonym for Risk across all domains.
conflict_notes: ISO 14971/RISKMAN hazard semantics differ from cyber Threat and generic ERM cause/source.
preferred_label_rationale: Scope explicitly to Health/Safety unless W2 evidence supports broader identity.

source_native_variants: trigger; triggering event; threshold trigger; alert trigger
working_definition: A condition or occurrence that initiates, activates or signals a transition in a risk-relevant scenario, response or monitoring process.
broader_or_refinement: related to Risk Source and Risk Event
conflict_notes: Trigger may be causal, temporal, threshold-based or workflow-specific; not equivalent to Cause.
preferred_label_rationale: Explicit term prevents source/trigger/cause collapse.

source_native_variants: condition; predisposing condition; enabling condition; susceptibility condition
working_definition: A contextual state or disposition that increases susceptibility to a risk-relevant event/effect without necessarily being its direct cause.
broader_or_refinement: related to Vulnerability and Risk Source
conflict_notes: Condition is too broad without qualification; sources may call vulnerabilities/weaknesses causes.
preferred_label_rationale: Preferred label preserves non-causal enabling semantics.
